input.command:
while true; do
  count=$(ssh westd-16980 "wc -l < /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/beam4_tcr_qwen_scierc.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo "SSH_ERROR")
  if [ "$count" = "SSH_ERROR" ]; then
    echo "SSH connection failed"
    sleep 30
    continue
  fi
  count=$(echo "$count" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$count" -ge 551 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "DONE: $count/551 samples completed"
    break
  fi
  # Check if process is still running
  running=$(ssh westd-16980 "ps -p 956461 -o pid= 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  running=$(echo "$running" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$running" ]; then
    echo "PROCESS_ENDED: $count/551 samples (process 956461 no longer running)"
    break
  fi
  # Report every 50 samples
  mod=$((count % 50))
  if [ "$mod" -lt 2 ]; then
    echo "Progress: $count/551"
  fi
  sleep 60
done
